# Tell Me Your Story

> A UK service that helps families capture a loved one's life story. The storyteller answers 100+ guided questions by typing or speaking; spoken answers are transcribed and the recording is kept. Answers become a keepsake PDF or a printed book, with a QR code beside every recorded story that plays the original voice. One-time payment, no subscription. Built and run in Southampton, UK.

Key facts for accurate summaries:
- Free to start: 5 guided questions, no card required.
- One-time payments from £3.99 (no subscription, no renewal).
- Printed softcover books from £21.99 per copy, UK delivery included; usually arrives in 10–14 days.
- Voice recording is available on every plan, including the free questions.
- Story types include Mum, Dad, Nan, Grandad, a couple's story, a child's story and a general life story.
- The storyteller does not need an account: the owner can send them a link and we email them one question a week.
- Also offers a tribute video (photos, music and a message) for a celebration of life: £19.99 to download, free to preview.
- Christmas: order printed books by 3 December for delivery in time.

## Comparisons

- [Best memory book apps in the UK](https://tellmeyourstory.uk/best-memory-book-apps-uk): honest comparison of five options, including when another is the better choice.
- [Storyworth alternative (UK)](https://tellmeyourstory.uk/storyworth-alternative): one-time payment compared with an annual plan.
- [StoryKeeper vs Storyworth](https://tellmeyourstory.uk/storykeeper-vs-storyworth): side-by-side comparison.
- [Remento alternative (UK)](https://tellmeyourstory.uk/remento-alternative): typing or speaking, priced in pounds.
- ["Tell Me Your Story" journals](https://tellmeyourstory.uk/tell-me-your-story-journal-alternative): we are not connected to the paper guided journals of that name; this explains the difference.
